f7571490-2d22-451e-a748-d8a5387e4147.quote: We lost a 46-20 game to minion waves. Their players did 33,043 objective damage all game, less than Murdock's 65,804 alone, and still took thirteen structures to our six, because nine of those thirteen fell while we were killing a Fangtooth, a Prime or a Genesis Core somewhere else, and seven fell with nobody on our side dead. The pattern started at 12, an outer tower for our first Fangtooth at 11.7, became the rule from 31 to 35, our last inner tower and two inhibitors for a Genesis Core and a Primal Fangtooth, and ended the game at 45: six inhibitor kills, the sixth at 45.1, and the core at 45.4 while we were winning the fight at Orb Prime 4-1. Ten major objectives, none of them the one that ends a game. Next game: a won fight past minute 30 walks to a structure or the core, never to a camp.
